definitions: A medical condition where the patella (kneecap) moves out of its normal position in the trochlear groove of the femur.
The displacement of the kneecap from its proper alignment within the knee joint.
examples: He suffered a patellar dislocation during the football match.
Surgical intervention may be required for recurrent patellar dislocation.
Symptoms of patellar dislocation include pain and swelling.
